dash_privacy_3.message: Email text goes to the AI only when you click Write with AI or for emails that match an auto-reply rule you created — through our relay (never stored) for the built-in AI, or straight to your own provider.
dash_privacy_3.description: Privacy bullet about where email text goes

dash_sec_ai_short.description: One-line sidebar description of the AI writer

dash_sec_settings.description: Sidebar item + section title: Gmail connection and settings

dash_sec_settings_intro.description: Intro paragraph at the top of the settings section

toast_reload_tab.message: Canned Responses was updated — refresh this tab to keep using it.
